status: pre-registered (LR-11); later stages may add detail but must not change the primary test after seeing test data
binding: CONTRACT Amendment A2.1: the headline compares the learned model with the validation-selected best baseline (every policy one config tuned on pooled train data with the equal CMA-ES budget). Per-family best baselines and the per-cell oracle are secondary context only.

test_set.segment_note: FAST25 conversation cells share segment ids mooncake:w3/w5 (same arrival and length skeleton, B2 decision D2), so they are averaged into those segments; cells at different N, level, transform or load mode of one segment are one workload (LR-11).

replicates: 3 CRN replicates per (policy, cell), k = 0, 1, 2 (Amendment A1), paired against the best baseline on the same replicate
per_cell_statistic: mean over replicates of clip(log(goodput_rps_window(learned) / goodput_rps_window(best_baseline)), -log 3, +log 3) (LR-01 clipped log-ratio; eps as implemented by the harness)
per_segment_statistic: mean of the per-cell statistic over the segment's test cells

primary_test.test: one-sided exact Wilcoxon signed-rank test over the 12 segment statistics, H1: median > 0
primary_test.power_note: with 12 segments the exact one-sided test can reach p < 0.05; per-family claims have 2-4 segments and are descriptive only

effect_size.metric: P(learned > best baseline) over segments with a bootstrap 95% CI resampling segments (cluster bootstrap carrying all of a segment's cells)
effect_size.meaningful_if: CI upper bound > 0.75 (Bouthillier et al. gamma)
also_report: IQM and geometric mean of segment ratios with CIs
arithmetic mean of per-cell ratios (contract objective form)
per-cell winner map and gap to the per-cell best tuned baseline

stratification.load_mode: every table and the bootstrap are also reported per load mode (open loop, closed loop, lanes), LR-09
stratification.worker_count: per-N results (N in 2, 4, 6, 8, 16, 32) with Holm correction across N for any per-N significance claim
stratification.transform_extrapolation: the 10 transform_extrapolation cells are reported as their own stratum
stratification.family: per-family results are descriptive only (fewer than 6 segments each)

parity_and_no_regression.n2: LR-12: |delta| within the minimum detectable effect at N = 2 counts as parity, not failure; N = 2 is reported separately
parity_and_no_regression.tost_margin: +-0.5% normalized goodput for learned-choice@theta0 == default parity and for any 'no regression at unseen N' claim
parity_and_no_regression.mde: max(1%, 2 x SE of the paired segment mean measured on validation at the pilot) (LR-02)

robustness_reported_not_tested: SLO-scale re-scoring at 0.5, 0.75, 1, 1.5, 2, 3 x (I, S) from per_request rows (A2.2, LR-08); REPORT states where the headline flips
router-state lag 0, 50, 200 ms on the frozen test cells (Amendment A5)
timing perturbation speedup_ratio / decode_speedup_ratio 0.8 and 1.2 (PLAN stage 5)
counting: every learned-model variant (rung, rank, feature set, restart) evaluated on validation is counted and reported (LR-11 action 3)
